h1: The 8 Best White Nightstands of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 8 white nightstands compared on size, drawer style, charging ports and weight capacity, from plain two-drawer to LED smart units.
summary: The SONGMICS BELLAH is the best white nightstand if you want charging: five ports and a 66 lb capacity rating with an anti-tip kit. For the simplest buy, the Sweetcrispy two-drawer has no electronics and the cheapest tag here. For a raised bed, the WLIVE three-drawer is the tallest at 29.5 inches. The Yoobure is the pick if you want FCC and ETL certified wiring.
intro: White nightstands look simple until you notice how different they are under the surface: some have drawers, some have outlets, some have LED strips, and heights range from about 20 to nearly 30 inches. A table that is the wrong height for your bed is annoying every night.

We reviewed eight current white nightstands on paper, focusing on dimensions, charging, drawer type and capacity. All but one use fabric drawers, which is typical for this price tier, and we ranked them on how well each option solves a real bedside problem.

products.name: SONGMICS BELLAH White 2-Drawer Nightstand with 5 Charging Ports
products.verdict: Five charging ports, a 66 lb capacity and an anti-tip kit in one tidy table.
products.description:
The BELLAH measures 15.6 x 11.8 x 23.8 inches and combines two drawers with two AC outlets, two USB-A and one USB-C port. It adds app-controlled LED with music sync and ships with an anti-tip kit.

It wins because it has the most charging ports here and a stated 66 lb capacity, the strongest rating among the charging models. The LED is a bonus rather than the point.

Buy it if your bedside needs power for a phone, a lamp and a tablet. The caveat is the particleboard and PVC leather construction, which is typical for the price tier, not solid wood.
products.idealFor: Bedsides that need to power several devices.
products.skipIf: You want a plain, no-electronics table.

products.name: WLIVE White 3-Drawer Fabric Dresser Nightstand
products.verdict: The tallest pick at 29.5 inches, with three removable fabric drawers.
products.description:
WLIVE makes a 15.7 x 11.8 x 29.5 inch table, the tallest in this guide, with an MDF top, steel frame and three removable, foldable fabric drawers. It has no charging ports.

It ranks second because height is a rare, useful trait: a raised bed needs a taller table, and this one doubles as a slim dresser. The BELLAH has more features, but this one fits more beds.

Best for a bed with a high mattress. The caveat is no power, so you will need a separate charger.
products.idealFor: High beds that need a taller table.

products.name: BOLUO White 2-Drawer Nightstand with LED and USB-C
products.verdict: Removable wooden handles, adjustable feet and LED with 20 plus colors.
products.description:
BOLUO measures 15.7 x 11.8 x 23.6 inches with two fabric drawers, two AC outlets and two USB ports, and an LED with more than 20 DIY colors. Removable wooden handles and adjustable feet are the distinguishing details.

It ranks third because the customizing is fun but the power count is lower than the BELLAH. Adjustable feet matter on uneven floors, which none of the plain tables here offer.

Best for a bedroom with a character. The caveat is that LED options are a feature, not a core need.
products.idealFor: Bedrooms with uneven floors or a custom style.
products.skipIf: You want a single plain look.

products.name: Yoobure White 3-Drawer Nightstand, FCC & ETL Certified
products.verdict: The only FCC and ETL certified pick, with an X-bar support frame.
products.description:
Yoobure measures 15.4 x 11.8 x 25.6 inches, with a solid wood frame, three fabric drawers, two USB and two AC ports. It lists 16 RGB colors and 22 modes, FCC and ETL certification, and an X-bar support frame.

It ranks fourth because certification is a real reassurance for wiring beside a bed, but its feature count is lower than the BELLAH. It is the only certified model in the field.

Best for buyers who care about electrical safety marks. The caveat is that three drawers hold lighter loads than a hard cabinet.
products.idealFor: Anyone who wants certified bedside wiring.

products.name: WLIVE White 2-Drawer Nightstand with RGB LED, 3 USB Ports, 55 lb Capacity
products.verdict: Three USB ports, two AC outlets and a 55 lb capacity.
products.description:
WLIVE measures 15.67 x 11.73 x 25.19 inches with an MDF and steel build, two fabric drawers, three USB ports plus two AC outlets and an RGB LED controlled via the iStrip+ app. The top is waterproof and the capacity is 55 lb.

It ranks fifth because it has strong capacity and port counts but sits behind the BELLAH and Yoobure in features. It beats the BOLUO on capacity.

Best for bedsides with a heavier lamp or clock. The caveat is that the app is another thing to configure.

products.name: Somdot White Leather Nightstand with Voice-Sync LED, FSC Certified
products.verdict: FSC certified with a lead-free coating and voice, app and music LED control.
products.description:
Somdot measures 15.7 x 11.8 x 23.6 inches with E1 MDF and a powder-coated steel frame, two fabric drawers, two AC outlets, one USB-A and one USB-C. The LED takes voice, app, timer and music control, and the build is FSC certified with a lead-free coating.

It ranks sixth because the eco credentials are a genuine differentiator but the LED focus is a niche need. It beats the JOONEE on charging.

Best for buyers who care about materials certification. The caveat is a lower port count.
products.skipIf: You do not want an LED feature.

products.name: Sweetcrispy White 2-Drawer Nightstand with Arch Handles
products.verdict: The cheapest here: two fabric drawers, a water-resistant top, no electronics.
products.description:
Sweetcrispy measures 18 x 11.8 x 20 inches with a metal frame and engineered wood, two fabric drawers, arch handles and an end-stop design that stops drawers pulling out. It has no charging ports and a 44 lb capacity.

It ranks seventh only because it is the plainest. It is the cheapest in the list and at 20 inches it is the shortest, which suits a low bed.

Best for a low bed and a small budget. The caveat is no power.
products.idealFor: Low beds on a small budget.
products.skipIf: You want power at the bedside.

products.name: JOONEE White Nightstand with Vertical Texture and Solid Pine Legs
products.verdict: Solid pine legs, a vertical texture finish and a built-in charging station.
products.description:
JOONEE measures 15.7 x 11.8 x 25.2 inches with MDF and solid pine legs, two drawers, a charging station and an open shelf. It adds LED atmosphere lighting, a vertical textured paint and anti-slip rubber pads.

It ranks last because the design-forward look is the draw, not the specs. It is the only pick with genuine solid pine legs, which the others lack.

Best for a bedroom where looks come first. The caveat is a lower focus on capacity.
products.skipIf: You want a stated weight rating.

whatMatters.detail: A nightstand should sit within a few inches of the top of your mattress. In this guide heights range from about 20 to 29.5 inches. Measure from the floor to the top of your mattress before buying.
A phone, lamp and tablet need at least three sockets. AC outlets power lamps and USB ports charge devices. Count your devices and pick a table with more ports than you need today.
Wiring inside furniture should carry an electrical safety mark such as ETL. Only the Yoobure lists FCC and ETL here. If you care about it, check the listing for named certification.
Most picks use fabric drawers, which are light and removable but not for heavy items. Plan to keep books and small items inside, not weight. Check capacity ratings.
Anti-tip kits and adjustable feet help on uneven floors and around kids. Check the listing for them.

faq.q: What height should a nightstand be?
faq.a: Roughly level with the top of your mattress, give or take a few inches. In this guide, the Sweetcrispy sits at 20 inches and the WLIVE three-drawer at 29.5.

faq.q: Do I need a nightstand with charging?
faq.a: If you plug in more than one device, yes. The SONGMICS BELLAH has five ports, while the Sweetcrispy has none.
They hold light items such as books and chargers. Heavy objects belong on top, and the stated capacity on the listing is the limit.
It is a nice-to-have. Models such as the Somdot, BOLUO and WLIVE RGB offer app or voice control. If you sleep with a bright room, skip it.
Yes. Some, like the Sweetcrispy and the WLIVE two-drawer, list roughly 15 minute assembly. Check the listing for each.

faq.q: How do I keep a nightstand from tipping?
faq.a: Use the anti-tip kit where provided, such as on the SONGMICS BELLAH, and adjust feet on uneven floors.

finalTake: For most bedrooms, the SONGMICS BELLAH is the right buy: five charging ports, 66 lb capacity and an anti-tip kit. For a raised bed, the WLIVE three-drawer is the tallest at 29.5 inches. For certified wiring, take the Yoobure. On a tight budget, the Sweetcrispy is the cheapest.
